snippet.title: Invicta
snippet.description:
Welcome to Invicta, the home for history documentary videos on fascinating people and places from the past. We cover all sorts of historical topics such as the war of Alexander the Great in Persia, the politics of Julius Caesar in Ancient Rome, the fashion of kings in Medieval times, and much more. snippet.title: Urban Legends & Lost Histories
snippet.description:
Every city has two histories.

The one they teach you in school and the one buried beneath the streets.

Urban Legends & Lost Histories is a journey through the world's most extraordinary cities: their forgotten empires, vanished civilizations, dark secrets, and the myths that outlived them all.

From the underground tunnels of Rome to the cursed districts of ancient Babylon. From the city that was built on a lie to the capital that disappeared overnight. We dig beneath the surface and what we find changes everything you thought you knew.

A new city. Every 3 days. Each one a different story. Each one a chapter history almost erased.

If you've ever looked at a city and wondered what happened here before all of this… you're in the right place.

Subscribe. The past is waiting.
